title: Joseph Interprets Pharaoh's Dreams
description: Joseph interprets Pharaoh's dreams about seven fat and seven lean cows, and seven full and seven thin ears of grain, and is placed over all Egypt to prepare the land for the famine.

versions.reason: [major] references: The story overlaps with the existing 'Joseph's Exaltation in Egypt' (41:37-57). The new story covers the entire chapter 41 and includes both the dream interpretation and the exaltation.
